_comment: SAMPLE harvest for the 3 geographies that had ZERO data (Townships, 2010 Blockgroups, Metropolitan Statistical Areas 2013). Exact reporting-level strings discovered via harvest.geoprobe.json. Study area = Counties seed 18097 (known-good nav; one selected geo still reports all geos of the chosen level across the default region). Indicator groups are small DECENNIAL demographics/housing + one regional ACS economic group — the kinds that actually publish at these fine/regional levels (the earlier sample used ACS marital/household indicators that don't). Fully isolated output/state (geo3_*) so it never touches the live priority harvest. gridWaitSec high because blockgroup grids return thousands of rows.

includePaths: Economy › Employment Statistics › Labor Force › Total
